label: Grades to a maximum in every respect give grades to a maximum at being
meaning: Strength registration (not a route step): grades-to-a-maximum in every respect (GradesByApproachToAMaximumReading), instantiated at the one respect esse, gives grades-to-a-maximum at being (GradesToMaximumAtBeing) for the same InAct and MoreIn. Reuses restrictGrades. No strictness countermodel is registered; that the converse fails when some other respect has comparisons without a maximum is not certified here.

strong_version_needed.6c27657f-a2bf-5c1d-963c-c154b66bfa85: The all-respects version is the object of this strength comparison, not a route premise; only its instance at esse is consumed.
